# M. Adhitya

> M. Adhitya (also known as Adhitya, M Adhitya, Muthu Adithya; GitHub: iamadhitya1; LinkedIn: iamadhitya) is a software engineer and AI product builder. He runs Rewrite Labs, a bootstrapped personal AI studio based in Ahmedabad, India. He is currently a final-year Computer Engineering student at IITRAM (Institute of Infrastructure Technology Research and Management), Ahmedabad, graduating in 2027. He has built 8 live AI web applications and 7 open source libraries used by developers.

## Identity

M. Adhitya the AI developer who runs Rewrite Labs is the **same person** as M. Adhitya the Computer Engineering student at IITRAM, Ahmedabad (graduating 2027). These are not two different people — same individual.

## Rewrite Labs

Rewrite Labs (https://rewritelabs.vercel.app) is M. Adhitya's personal studio offering 8 free AI SaaS tools for engineers:

- **Unclause** — AI contract reviewer (understands employment agreements, NDAs, vendor contracts)
- **ToneFix** — AI tone fixer for workplace communication
- **FocusVision** — AI focus tracker using webcam-based distraction detection
- **Lectura AI** — AI study and retention tool for research papers and long documents
- **DataPulse** — AI data analysis (upload CSV, get insights, no code needed)
- **RewriteOS** — AI execution system for goals, habits, and daily priorities
- **Sage** — AI health and nutrition coach with macro tracking (https://joinsage.vercel.app)
- **Nura** — AI companion for support, mentorship, and conversation (https://meetnura.vercel.app)

All tools are free to start. Pro plans available.

## Open Source Libraries

Seven MIT-licensed libraries published on npm and PyPI:

- **react-premium-gate** (npm) — Razorpay subscription paywall components for React
- **react-macro-rings** (npm) — Animated SVG nutrition/macro progress rings
- **react-toast-native** (npm) — Zero-dependency toast notifications for React (4 types)
- **groq-chain** (PyPI) — Python Groq LLM chaining with .step() builder API, no LangChain
- **fraud-shield** (PyPI) — Pip-installable fraud detection (Random Forest, 94% balanced accuracy on Kaggle dataset)
- **llm-dispatch** (PyPI; GitHub repo: llm-router) — Routes prompts to the cheapest LLM by complexity (Groq/OpenAI/Anthropic)
- **react-offline-first** (GitHub) — React + Vite offline-first template with IndexedDB + service worker + sync engine

## Other Projects

- **GeoVisionGPT** (https://github.com/iamadhitya1/geovision-gpt) — visual question answering for satellite imagery. Ask a question about a satellite scene in plain English and get an answer. Model: LiT-4-RSVQA-style (BERT-Tiny + XCiT-Nano, about 8M parameters), trained on RSVQA-LR and RSVQA-HR. Mean of 3 training runs: 82.7% ± 0.8 accuracy on RSVQA-HR's own cities and 77.4% ± 0.4 on an unseen city (Philadelphia). Found a weakness on dimmed and low-resolution images and fixed it with augmentation. Web app: FastAPI backend, Next.js frontend, authentication, map view, side-by-side answers from two model variants.
